briefing.title: Training Range: First Steps
story: Your headquarters is online and the range is quiet. Your instructor wants to see you gather matter, raise a few buildings and put a handful of units in the field.
A training drone will test your defences before the session ends.
objectives: Harvest matter from the nearby fields
Build at least one new structure
tips: Select a unit and right-click a resource field to harvest it.
Open the Manual from the main menu for the full controls.
